expression_ic.description: Expression IC arrayop rule: discretizes an `ic` node (the synthetic initial-condition AST node, analogous to the `bc` node for boundary conditions) into an `arrayop` that evaluates the IC RHS expression at each grid cell. The engine substitutes each spatial-dim symbol with the cell-centre coordinate: x→coord_x($i), y→coord_y($j), z→coord_z($k), etc. (uniform: (idx - 0.5)*h; nonuniform: via coord_x const_array). `ghost_width: 0` declares that IC evaluation consumes no ghost cells. Full e2e wiring is by ESD `ic-u0` (replaces _eval_expression_ics) and ESS `ic-arrayop-engine` (materializes the ic dispatch).
